title: Krystal S Probable FDE 6891 NDE 6891
content: This story is strange, as no life threatening event happened. I'll start from the best place. I had moved into my own apartment for the first time. I had always lived with others until this time. I became aware of paranormal happenings in the home. From my assumptions, I gather that they are always around. However, since I was now on my own I feel they felt unrestrained. I can recall the first incident. My bedroom had used to be a back porch. The previous tenants converted it into a bedroom. Literally, all that fit in there was my queen- sized bed. I had slipped in there and shut the door to read. Suddenly, I heard people, activity, and voices. Someone said 'She's gone now!' I cleared my throat to make it aware I was still there. Just like that, someone said, 'She's still here!' From then on I was scared. I wouldn't sleep alone. I'd call my friends in from Wichita, which was 30 plus miles away, just so I could get a good night's sleep. During this time, I had experiences that kept happening: ghosts touching me, doors closing, footsteps running at me while reading my bible. I might add, at this time I became real interested in the bible, theology in general and history. So now, the stage is set for what happened that night: I was having a real bad night. I called in my friend, Tim, to come to stay over. We lay down and I hear footsteps pacing, angry footsteps sounding like boots. It was as if the person was frustrated and couldn't do anything. The bathroom door shut. I asked my friend to go check and see what was going on. He said 'You know what it is', he fell asleep. I sat awake, and then settled under his arm for protection. At that time, my sacredness went into absolute terror. I was bone chilled, blood cold scared. I was so fearful of what was in my house that I shut my eyes and thought 'Just do what you will and stop terrorizing me'. Next, I was no longer in my bedroom quarters. I was enveloped in a white light. A white light that shone so bright, but yet is not comparable to any artificial light or light from the sun. I looked down at myself, but this was not me. I was in a man's body, a tall lanky man. I'd estimate him to be young. The clothing he wore was a red t-shirt, denim carpenter-style, jean shorts and white sneakers. I recall a feeling of peace. I felt that the guy was me and I was him. But at the same time it was not me, but him making himself known to me. Then, as suddenly as it happened, I was back in my bed: no longer scared. I felt at peace. I went to sleep and woke up feeling confused at what happened. At the same time, there was a different air in my house. I never let my fear control me again after that. I was no longer afraid of the unknown, the ghost or paranormal happenings. I struggled a bit with how to deal after that. I now feel as if the being was showing me what it's like to die, or that I need not fear him. Perhaps he was protecting my soul from what was going on. This is such a crazy story, I feel compelled to add that I am prone to paranormal happenings of all sorts since a young age. When I was young, I died from a penicillin allergy. I do not remember that event. I was told by my mother that I went blue, in the car, after I was treated with medication for a brown recluse bite on the way home from the hospital.

arrival.other_being_detail: Experiencer perceived being in a tall, young, lanky man's body wearing a red t-shirt, denim carpenter-style jean shorts, and white sneakers; felt "the guy was me and I was him" yet also "not me, but him making himself known to me."

environment.environment_other_detail: Enveloped in a white light "not comparable to any artificial light or light from the sun."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: No life-threatening event; episode occurred during intense fear amid reported paranormal activity in apartment.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Experience included sudden transition from bed to being enveloped in white light and perceiving self as a young, tall, lanky man; then sudden return to bed.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No reported OBE vantage/tunnel/boundary; immediate light/identity-shift experience followed by sudden return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience occurred without a life-threatening event; experiencer perceived being in a different (male) body/identity within a bright white light.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Just do what you will and stop terrorizing me"; "I was enveloped in a white light"; "I was in a man's body"; "I felt that the guy was me and I was him."
